EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT, (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
I, hereby declare, as given in the Act of Acquisition of land 1964 No. 28, 7th sentence 1st sub sentence, the land described below is expected to be acquired for public purpose

Details of the Land to be acquired: The description of the land with 0.1359 Hectare mentioned in the basic plan No. Co 9479 prepared by the superintendent of survey, situated in the village of Udahamulla, Maharagama Divisional Secretariate, Colombo District in Western Province is given below:-
01. Lot No. 1

Name of the Land: Delgahawatta (The land in Thalapathpitiya Road, Tax No. 87/3); Description of the Land: There is a garden, a permanent building, permanent well, toilet pit, one Jak and a Mango tree about 20 years old a 12 years old Veralu tree, and a 8 years old Amberella tree; Owner claimed: S. M. K. Ranasinghe, No. 45/3, Chandraloka Mawatha, Kanaththa Rd, Udahamulla, Nugegoda; Extent: 0.0229 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 2

Name of the Land: Delgahawatta ; Description of the Land: Garden, Permanent building, part of a permanent building, a 14 years old king coconut tree, and a 20 years old coconut tree; Owner claimed: Kamala Piyasili, No. 241, Old Road, Mulleriyawa North, Angoda; Extent: 0.0191 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 3

Name of the Land: Delgahawatta (The land in Thalapathpitiya Road, Tax No. 87); Description of the Land: Garden, Permanent well and a part of a permanent building; Owner claimed: P. W. A. D. Grace Leen, No. 87, Thalapathpitiya Road, Udahamulla, Nugegoda; Extent: 0.0220 Hectare.
04. Lot No. 4

Name of the Land: Delgahawatta; Description of the Land: Entrance; Owner claimed: S. M. K. Ranasinghe, No. 45/3, Chandraloka Mawatha, Kanaththa Rd, Udahamulla, Nugegoda., Senadeerage Don Ranjith, No. 87/2, Thalapathpitiya Road, Udahamulla, Nugegoda., Kamala Piyasili, No. 241, Old Road, Mulleriyawa North, Angoda and Deepika Wickramatunge, Karanketiya, Rakwana; Extent: 0.0111 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 5 Name of the Land: Delgahawatta; Description of the Land: Garden, Permanent Well and a 15 years old bread fruit tree; Owner claimed: Namalee Senadeera, the address cannot be located; Extent: 0.0207 Hectare.

06. Lot No. 6 Name of the Land: Delgahawatta; Description of the Land: Garden, a toilet pit, part of a toilet pit and a 15 years old breadfruit tree; Owner claimed: Deepika Wickramatunge, Karanketiya, Rakwana; Extent: 0.0186 Hectare.

07. Lot No. 7 Name of Land: Delgahawatta (The land in Thalapathpitiya Road, Tax No. 87/2); Description of the Land: Garden, Permanent building a temporary building, part of a toilet pit 14 years old king coconut tree and a 12 years old tamarind tree; Owner claimed: Senadeerage Don Ranjith, No. 87/2, Thalapathpitiya Road, Udahamulla, Nugegoda; Extent: 0.0215 Hectare.

All who claimed to own, have rights to own or declare other affairs or who are eligible to own or have documents from responsible authority must meet me on 11th March 2015 from 9.00 a.m. at Maharagama Divisional Secretariat office.

Further, before 04th of March 2015, the details of the nature of the owner ship, the reason to claim compensation, compensation amount, and how it had been prepared should be submitted to me with 2 copies. The documents and the deeds, the title reports relevant to prove the ownership should be submitted to me at the inspection.
BUDDHI THARANGA KARUNASENA, Divisional Secretary, Maharagama. Divisional Secretariat office Maharagama. 03 - 131
AMENDMENT
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under the Section 7
My Reference No.: Wa/18/56/2001/II.

THE Notice published in the Extraordinary Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka No. 1629/7 on 23rd November, 2009, Preliminary Plan No. Gam. 3718 stated as Lot No. 96. It should be amended as Lot Nos. 178 and 179.
Lot No. 178 Name of the land: Gorakagahawatta; Description: Garden; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: J. A. Piriyanka, No. 128/1, Thapowanarama Road, Maththumagala, Ragama; Extent: 0.0005 Hectare.

Lot No. 179 Name of the land: Gorakagahawatta; Description: Garden, a part of Permanent Building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Hettiarachchige Kusumawaththie, No. 128/1, Thapowanarama Road, Maththumagala, Ragama; Extent: 0.0009 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands, Lot Nos. 178 and 179 are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat, Wattala on the 18th day of March, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 18th day of March 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
W. G. PREMALAL, Divisional Secretary, Wattala.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Wattala, 16th February, 2015.
